Courage the Cowardly dog is NOT who he appears to be. In fact, I think he’s the REAL monster here. Don’t you think it’s weird that we keep seeing the same exact creature every single episode? Something strange is going on here in the Middle of Nowhere and I’m here to get to the bottom of it in today’s episode!
